_readme: Known-dangling references inside sot/*.md, recorded 2026-08-28. This file may only SHRINK. CI rejects any PR that adds an entry. Burn-down is Station 05's job: fix the reference in sot/, then delete its entry here in the same PR. See docs/pipeline/stations/05-sot-keeper.md. TRAP (MEASURED 2026-08-28 @82ba8538): check-sot-refs.mjs resolves with existsSync against the WORKING TREE, so an entry can read as 'already resolved' on a dev box purely because its target is a gitignored local artifact. Six entries here do exactly that -- the dev tree printed '20 baselined' while a clean worktree off origin/main printed '26' at the same SHA. Before deleting any entry, prove the target is on main: git cat-file -e origin/main:<path>. Deleting an entry that only resolves locally turns it into a hard CI failure. STRUCTURAL FLOOR (MEASURED 2026-08-29 @fb3cc64b; `git check-ignore -v` per target, positive control: sot/README.md is tracked): 8 of these 23 entries point at targets that are GITIGNORED BY DESIGN, so the sot/ reference is CORRECT and the entry can never be burned down by fixing anything -- apps/api/scripts/xero-import-report.md (.gitignore:85; sot/03:7437, :7464), docs/data-model/relationship-map.md (.gitignore:127; sot/04:9), docs/qa/qa-checklist.md (.gitignore:106; sot/04:4467, :4482), docs/qa/qa-findings.md (.gitignore:107; sot/04:4467), docs/pr-prompts/needs-marco/pr-188-authz-findings.md (.gitignore:82; sot/06:3094), graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md (.gitignore:133; sot/README.md:190). THE BURN-DOWN FLOOR IS 8, NOT 0. The other 15 are the real debt and every one of them needs a judgement call about a deleted doc, so none is auto-fixable. Six of the eight are exactly the entries that resolve on a dev box: this tree printed 17 baselined while a clean worktree off origin/main printed 23 at the same SHA.
